avis.titre: For the price, it's absolutely pointless.
avis.texte: I'm a lover of skincare. I'm someone who likes DE. I got this because after using PC Retinol a few times a week and then started alternating DE Vitamin C mask (which is phenomenal) I started to get really dried out. My skin was tight so I wanted to try a moisturizing mask at night to help. This only helped for a few hours and the next morning I was back in the same place I was. I tried consistently for 5 weeks to make sure my I got real results and unfortunately this is just a particular product is an over inflated thick moisturizer. I understand that is supposed to be the point but my god, there are 10000's of moisturizing facials on the market that show better results with a 1/4 of the price. Bottom line, this is 100% not worth the pricetag.

avis.titre: Love this stuff and it works.
avis.texte: I have MCAS and thus very reactive skin. This worked to hydrate and calm my skin, the only con for me is the price.

Can be used overnight as the last step in your routine or daytime you can add a pump in with your morning serums. A couple pumps is all you need and it lasts a good while! Worth the $$ in my opinion.

The product itself is amazing. Unfortunately, it only works a few times before the pump malfunctions and won't distribute any product. I took the first bottle back to Ulta and they gave me a new one, only for that one to stop working even quicker than the first.

avis.titre: Will buy again in different bottle

avis.titre: Don't buy this product, the pump system is defective!

avis.titre: why does this pump not work?
avis.texte: I have to constantly take the lid off to use this. The pump never, ever works. It is either defective or a poor design

avis.titre: Product is great.  Pump is not.

Great concept but the actual design and functionality fell away short. If the delivery system can be improved upon and actually work as intended, definitely a five-star product. But I shouldn't have to shake the container, prime the container, or do anything other than just simply press down in order to get product out.

avis.titre: TAP THE BOTTLE ON THE COUNTER

This formula is luxuriously thick, and it causes the pump to not rise up as well as in other products, so you might have to tap the bottle on the counter or kind of hit the side with the heel of your hand to get it to release the pressure and dispense more product. I also thought the pump was defective, but as none of my other DE pumps have been, I tried tapping it pretty hard then pumping, and it worked like a charm! I LOVE all DE products, especially this one for winter with my dry/more mature skin. I wake up glowing and looking refreshed when I top my night smoothie (Framboos/lala/a-gloei) with it. Highly recommend!
I loved this because its so hydrating and does not leave irritation!

avis.titre: Like a Liquid IV for your skin
avis.texte: This product adds extra hydration to dry, combo, or normal skin, and the results have truly impressed me. One of the standout features of this product is its lightweight and smooth formula. It feels like a breath of fresh air on the skin, and I love how quickly it absorbs. Unlike other masks that can leave your skin greasy, this product leaves it feeling nourished and refreshed. However, it's essential to mention that while I personally adore this product, it may not be for everyone. Some individuals may experience a stinging sensation upon application. If you're skin one of the lucky ones who can tolerate its you'll likely be as pleased with the results as I am.

I love ending my nightly routine (Beste, TLC Framboos, Hydra B, Oil, Lala Whipped) with F Balm, but I won't be repurchasing because of the packaging. My bottle is at least half full still, but it won't come out with the pump. I have tried the suggestion of shaking it and pressing the button for 1-2 minutes, but it doesn't work. I guess I'll just scrape out what I can. Such a waste, because I really do feel a difference in my skin when I use F Balm.
